title: Discriminatory Layoffs, Frontier Standards, and the Great AI Price War
description: Meta faces a lawsuit over AI-driven layoffs that allegedly targeted disabled and on-leave employees, while Demis Hassabis floats a US 'Standards Body' for frontier models. Plus: startups defect to cheap Chinese AI, India's agentic boom, and whispers of a stopgap Gemini as 3.5 Pro slips again.
